Application for Official Plan Amendment OP 26-13-7 – JM Braun Inc.
The purpose of the Application for Official Plan Amendment is to add a site-specific policy to a portion of the subject lands in the Town of Tillsonburg, to permit outdoor sales and display of finished product accessory to a permitted use. It is proposed that approximately 45% of the subject land (northeast corner) will be used as outdoor display and sales area for finished trailers.
*See Report CP 2026-323

RECOMMENDATIONS:
That Oxford County Council approve Application OP 26-13-7, submitted by JM Braun Inc., for lands legally described as Part Block 1, Plan 41M-381 in the Town of Tillsonburg to permit site specific provisions to allow approximately 45% of the subject lands to be used for outdoor sales and display of finished product as accessory to permitted use;
And further, that Council approve the attached Amendment Number 372 to the County of Oxford Official Plan as well as enacting By-Law 6893-2026.
